# Browse

Vira > [Modules](../../README.md) > [Library](../README.md) > Browse

The subject tree over a vault, and reading a subject whole.

`library.py` builds the tree from the vault's folders and frontmatter
and serves a subject as one readable page; `library.js` is the window.

## What lives here

Everything below is generated from `module.json` and the files themselves. Scripts, assets, tests and documents that belong to this submodule are listed here even while they still sit in the shared top-level folders; see "Moving code" in the root README.
